hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: lookup structure on the total time t in the range [1, len(changeIndices)].

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For a fixed prefix of length t, each index i should be marked at its last appearance in changeIndices[:t].

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Traverse forward; if current second is the last appearance of an index, ensure accumulated decrement credits cover nums[i].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on earliest second with greedy verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy without binary search lacks global optimality for scheduling decrements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for last occurrence tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use binary search on monotonic feasibility and postpone marks to last available slots.
